class.name: EditorCard
class.brief_description: A bordered editor surface with standard header, body, and footer regions.
class.description: [b]Experimental:[/b] This class may be changed or removed in future versions. Provides consistent grouping, spacing, collapse behavior, and action placement for editor interfaces.

method.name: add_body_control
method.description: Adds [param control] to the padded body region.

method.name: add_footer_action
method.description: Adds an action button to the trailing side of the footer.

method.name: add_footer_control
method.description: Adds [param control] to the trailing-aligned footer.

method.name: add_header_action
method.description: Adds an action button to the card header.

method.name: clear_body
method.description: Removes and deletes all controls in the body.

method.name: clear_footer
method.description: Removes and deletes all controls in the footer.

method.name: get_header
method.description: Returns the section header used by this card.

members.member: Short state or count shown in the header.
Whether the body and footer are hidden.
Whether the card can be collapsed.

signal.name: toggled
signal.description: Emitted when collapse state changes through the header.
